text: {"rules": [], "notes": "M.G.L. c. 186, § 31 only requires that a notice to quit for nonpayment of rent be accompanied by a state-developed information form, and that courts not accept summary process filings without proof the form was delivered. It does not limit evictions to listed causes, set a just-cause termination notice tied to such limits, or provide relocation assistance. It also says nothing on rent increases, deposits, application fees, screening, or algorithmic pricing, so no in-scope rule is recorded."}
